34:32.text: And those who were arrogant will say to those who were deemed weak: "Did we keep you back from guidance after it had come to you? Nay, but you were Mujrimûn

34:33.text: Those who were deemed weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Nay, but it was your plotting by night and day: when you ordered us to disbelieve in Allâh and set up rivals to Him!" And each of them
(for disobeying Allâh during this worldly life)
, when they behold the torment. And We shall put iron collars round the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught except what they used to do?

34:34.text: And We did not send a warner to a township but those who were given the worldly wealth and luxuries among them said: "We believe not in the
with which you have been sent."

34:35.text: And they say: "We are more in wealth and in children, and we are not going to be punished."

34:36.text: : "Verily, my Lord enlarges the provision to whom He wills and restricts, but most men know not."

34:37.text: And it is not your wealth, nor your children that bring you nearer to Us
; as for such, there will be twofold reward for what they did, and they will reside in the high dwellings

34:38.text: And those who strive against Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, to frustrate them, they will be brought to the torment.

34:39.text: Say: "Truly, my Lord enlarges the provision for whom He wills of His slaves, and
for him, and whatsoever you spend of anything
, He will replace it. And He is the Best of providers."
